values.note: 2026 daily rates for 2 adults: 50-amp water/electric back-in $48, pull-through $50; 50-amp full hookup back-in $53, pull-through $58; tent site (20-amp water/electric) $37. Extra adult $7 a day. Weekly $288-348; monthly $630-750 plus metered electric. $4 processing fee per reservation; optional $10 'Lock Site' fee.

fees.source: https://starlightcampground.com/rates-reservations.html ('2026 Campsite & Rental Rates'; 'Water and Electric 50 amp, Back In $48.00'; 'Full Hook-Up 50 amp W/E/S, Pull-Thru $58.00') + https://starlightcampground.com/site-map-rules.html ('There is a $4.00 processing fee for reservations'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online (Firefly) or by phone, up to 365 days ahead; one night's deposit. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day) need 2 nights. Monthly stays by phone. Cancel by phone more than 48 hours out ($10 fee).

booking.source: https://starlightcampground.com/ ('Reservations can be made 365 days in advance of your arrival date by calling 231-535-0461 or by booking online') + https://starlightcampground.com/site-map-rules.html ('There is a 2-night minimum stay for holiday weekends'), read 2026-10-22

note: Family-run transient campground in the pines off M-88 south of Mancelona (3060 Mancelona Rd), with a hiking trail, a pool, tent sites and vintage and modern trailer rentals; themed weekends, including Starry Nights during the August Perseids. --Claude
summary: Operator's site confirms 2026 rates $48 (50-amp W/E back-in) to $58 (full-hookup pull-through), 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, season May 8 - Oct 11, online booking 365 days ahead; phone 231-535-0461 matches. Added the $4 per-reservation processing fee, holiday 2-night minimum, Firefly url, showers/laundry/store/dump. Base $48 under US$50; no gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here.
